items.name: The Mask
items.description:
Begin with clean, dry skin. Leave for at least an hour but also can be used overnight, every night for maximum results. Wash with room temperature water and continue with your own ritual or use our face and body butter for some moisture.
A clean, botanical formula made in small batches — part of The Gypsi ritual.
